verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              प्रियः सर्वस्य लोकस्य सर्वसत्त्वाभिनन्दिता । गुणैः सर्वैरुपेतश्च को न्वस्ति भुवि मानवः ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said What man is there who is dear to all, who pleases all persons, and who is gifted with every merit and every accomplishment?

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पृच्छतो भरतर्षभ । उग्रसेनस्य संवादं नारदे केशवस्य च ॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma said About it I shall recite to you the words that Keshava, asked by Ugrasena, said to him on a former occasion.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रसेन उवाच । यस्य संकल्पते लोको नारदस्य प्रकीर्तने । मन्ये स गुणसम्पन्नो ब्रूहि तन्मम पृच्छतः ॥३॥
verses.english: Ugrasena said All persons seem to be auxious to describe of the merits of Narada. I think that celestial Rishi must really be endued with every sort of merit. I ask you tell me this, O Keshava.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच । कुकुराधिप यान्मन्ये शृणु तान्मे विवक्षतः । नारदस्य गुणान् साधून् संक्षेपेण नराधिप ॥४॥
verses.english: Vasudeva said O chief of the Kukuras, listen to me as I describe shortly those good qualities of Narada which I know, I king! Narada is as well-read in the scriptures as he is good and pious in his conduct

verses.sanskrit: न चारित्रनिमित्तोऽस्याहंकारो देहतापनः । अभिन्नश्रुतचारित्रस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥५॥
verses.english: And yet, he is not proud of his conduct, which makes one's blood so hot. It is for this that he is adored everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: अरतिक्रोधचापल्ये भयं नैतानि नारदे । अदीर्घसूत्रः शूरश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥६॥
verses.english: Discontent, anger, levity, and fear, do not exist in Narada. He is free from procrastination, and endued with courage. For this he is adored everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यो नारदो बाढं वाचि नास्य व्यतिक्रमः । कामतो यदि वा लोभात्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥७॥
verses.english: Narada deserves the respectful adorations of all. He never retracts his words through desire of cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यात्मविधितत्त्वज्ञः क्षान्तः शक्तो जितेन्द्रियः । ऋजुश्च सत्यवादी च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥८॥
verses.english: He is fully conversant with the knowledge of the soul, bent on peace, endued with great energy, and a master of his senses. He is free from guile, and truthful in words. For this he is adored with respect everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन विनयेन च । जन्मना तपसा वृद्धस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥९॥
verses.english: He is distinguished by energy, fame, intelligence, knowledge, humility, birth, by penances, and years. For these he is everywhere adored with respect.

verses.sanskrit: सुशीलः सुखसंवेशः सुभोजः स्वादरः शुचिः । सुवाक्यश्चाप्यनीर्ष्यश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१०॥
verses.english: He is of good conduct. He dresses and houses himself well. He cats pure food. He loves all. He is pure in body and mind. He is sweet-speeched. He is free from envy and malice. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणं कुरुते बाढं पापमस्मिन्न विद्यते । न प्रीयते परानर्थैस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥११॥
verses.english: He is, forsooth, always employed in doing good to all people. No sin is in him. He never rejoices at other people's misfortunes. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

verses.sanskrit: वेदश्रुतिभिराख्यानैरर्थानभिजिगीषति । तितिक्षुरनवज्ञातस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१२॥
verses.english: He always tries to conquer all earthly desires by listening to Vedic recitations and attending to the Puranas. He is a great renouncer and he never disrespects any one. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

verses.sanskrit: समत्वाच्च प्रियो नास्ति नाप्रियश्च कथंचन । मनोऽनुकूलवादी च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१३॥
verses.english: He is endued with great learning in the scriptures. His conversation is varied and charming. His knowledge and wisdom are great. He is free from cupidity. He is free also from deception. He is large-hearted. He has conquered anger and cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

verses.sanskrit: बहुश्रुतश्चित्रकथः पण्डितोऽलालसोऽशठः । अदीनोऽक्रोधनोऽलुब्धस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१४॥
नार्थे धने वा कामे वा भूतपूर्वोऽस्य विग्रहः । दोषाश्चास्य समुच्छिन्नास्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१५॥
verses.english: His devotion (to Brahma) is firm. His soul is blameless. He is well-versed in the Shrutis. He is free from cruelty. He is above the influence of delusion or faults. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

verses.sanskrit: दृढभक्तिरनिन्द्यात्मा श्रुतवाननृशंसवान् । वीतसम्मोहदोषश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१६॥
verses.english: He is unattached to all objects of attachment (for others). For all that he seems to be attached to all things. He does not suffer long from the influence of any doubt. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

verses.sanskrit: असक्तः सर्वसङ्गेषु सक्तात्मेव च लक्ष्यते । अदीर्घसंशयो वाग्मी तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१७॥
समाधिर्नास्य कामार्थे नात्मानं स्तौति कर्हिचित् । अनीर्षुर्मृदुसंवादस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१८॥
लोकस्य विविधं चित्तं प्रेक्षते चाप्यकुत्सयन् । संसर्गविद्याकुशलस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥१९॥
नासूयत्यागमं कंचित्स्वनयेनोपजीवति । अवन्ध्यकालो वश्यात्मा तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥२०॥
कृतश्रमः कृतप्रज्ञो न च तृप्तः समाधितः । नित्ययुक्तोऽप्रमत्तश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥२१॥
नापत्रपश्च युक्तश्च नियुक्तः श्रेयसे परैः । अभेत्ता परगुह्यानां तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥२२॥
न हृष्यत्यर्थलाभेषु नालाभे तु व्यथत्यपि । स्थिरबुद्धिरसक्तात्मा तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥२३॥
तं सर्वगुणसम्पन्नं दक्षं शुचिमनामयम् । कालज्ञं च प्रियज्ञं च कः प्रियं न करिष्यति ॥२४॥
